scope: macOS title and character-selection window resizing, as clarified by the user
cause: The resize callback updated the 4:3 viewport but retained UI rectangles and title hit-test half extents at their original pixel size. The next prepare used the new projection size, clipping the old layout. Selection also retained its original session width/height.
fix: Resize loaded title rectangles and recompute constructor-truncated hit-test half extents.
Resize loaded selection rectangles and cached pointer coordinates, and update the owning selection session dimensions.
Scale the shared cursor and cached frontend pointer/motion values with the same viewport ratio.
Use the same resize path when draw detects a changed renderer extent; preserve fade/zoom/selection/music/actor state and existing prepared zero-step frames.

regression.before: The original frontend implementation, linked into the same new resource regression, fails at 640x480 after its first updated frame: a background channel is 0 instead of the independently sampled 28.
permanent_checks: tests/test_selection_ui.c: loaded rectangles/pointer scale; active fade/zoom/reveal/scroll/selection/music fields remain unchanged; zero or oversized dimensions reject atomically; same-size resize is inert.
tools/front_flow_probe.c: title shrinking, growing, square/widescreen/odd sizes, zero-step and updated snapshots against independently sampled op_00.bmp pixels within two byte levels.
tools/front_flow_probe.c: resize character selection while clicking all five profiles and continue its existing dialogue/game/pause/title regression.

validation.check: Full resource frontend flow including resize and pointer targets
validation.result: passed; title=242 selection=283 dialogue=1784 loading=375 opening=995 pause=136 return-title=141 photos=2

validation.check: Native game clock plus controller navigation resource flow
validation.result: passed; title=212 selection=273 dialogue=1514 loading=195 opening=497 pause=106 return-title=111 photos=2
validation.limit: Ran four title target sizes before adding the odd-size fixture; same production fix.

validation.result: passed: title 960x720 to 640x480 points, renderer 1920x1440 to 1280x960; selection then grows to a 1000x600-point window / 2000x1200-pixel renderer with centered 1600x1200 content, profile click and complete UI visible
validation.method: Temporary native probe uses bk_platform_open/poll/take_resize and bk_renderer_create_window/resize, then production PlaySession resize/step/draw. SDL_SetWindowSize drives a real window; this is not a human drag/fullscreen acceptance test.

environment.assets: User-installed game resources read-only; no existing user save/settings were used
environment.outputs: Ignored build/validation/resize; separate capture/save fixtures. The native probe writes settings only under newly created /tmp/bk-window-resize-* directories.

limits: Other scenes' dynamic window-resize layouts were not audited in this task.
No exhaustive story run, fullscreen/monitor migration acceptance or Switch hardware check.
No delivery bundle was overwritten; the updated executable is build-macos/biko3.
LeakSanitizer was disabled; ASan/UBSan results do not prove absence of leaks.
